62939: She was born into the distinguished family of the Nishizumi Style of Sensha-do, but she changed schools to Ooarai Girls Academy intending to run away from Sensha-do. However, perplexingly enough, she was extorted into joining Sensha-do by the student council.
62941: Hana's friend and the other girl who befriended Miho during the first day of school. She is a social butterfly and is incredibly talkative. She yearns for a love that will love everything in the world, despite never being in a relationship before.
62943: A member of Anko Team and the Team's gunner. A beautiful girl who has a gentle and composed demeanor, and is the other girl alongside Saori who befriended Miho during the first day.
62945: A member of Anko Team, and the loader of the Team. She gets overly excited when she sees or hears anything about tanks - to put it, she is a tank otaku. Yukari has had a deep love for all things tanking and WW2 since a young age.
62947: A member of Anko Team and is the team's driver. She is a quiet and gloomy girl who falls easily asleep, and hates mornings. She is also weak to certain conditions. She is late to school everyday but is top of the class and can learn things almost instantly just by reading.
65267: Student Council President and commander of Team E, which is also called "Turtle Team." She is manipulative, childish and care-free girl who lets Momo and Yuzuko do all the tank operations while she just sits by as if she the passenger. She forces Miho to participate in Sensha-do.
65269: Student Council Vice-President. She is a brown-haired, well endowed girl who works mostly in the Student Council, does all the work as Anzu shoves it at her. She is also their team's driver.
65271: Momo is a third year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's also the PR manager of her school's student council. She started as the gunner and loader of Turtle Team, and when its Panzer 38(t) was converted into a Hetzer she took her definitive position of loader.
67475: She is the tank commander/loader of Team B (also called "Duck Team"), her team is composed of members of the school's Volleyball team. Her team operates a Japanese Type 89 "Otsu."
67477: Taeko seems to be the most sociable of her teammates, even if she appears rather quiet and possibly introverted. She has a gentle, friendly demeanor, and never seems to lose her temper, even in desperate situations.
67479: Shinobu is a first year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's also a member of the volleyball varsity team and her specialty is attacking. She's also the driver of the Duck Team's Type 89B "I-Go" tank, and is often the unintentional tsukkomi within the volleyball team.
67481: Akebi is a first year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's also a member of the volleyball varsity team and her specialty is blocking. She's also the gunner of Duck Team's Japanese Type 89B.
67483: She is leader of the "History Girls" team. Is partial to Roman history, as she's always reading books on it. Her role is Loader in Hippo Team.
67485: She heads Team C which is composed mainly of Reki-jo (History Buffs), which is also called "Hippo Team." Her team operates a Sturmgeschütz III or more commonly called "StuG III.
67487: In regards to the history of the Bakumatsu, she is unrivaled. She especially reveres Sakamoto Ryouma. She is a member of the Hippo Team and serves as the Driver.
67489: There is no one more knowledgeable in the Warring States Period of Japan. Her favorite food is "Sanada Konetsuke Mochi" She's a member of Hippo team, serves as Gunner.
67491: She is the commander of "Rabbit team", whose unit is compose of first-year students of Ooarai Girls High School. Her team operates a US M3 Lee or more commonly called "General Lee".
67493: Ayumi is a first year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She operates the sponson-mounted 75mm gun of the Rabbit Team's M3 Lee.
67495: Saki is a first year student of Ooarai Girls Academy. She is part of Rabbit Team and serves as the 37mm loader of the M3 Lee. A stoic girl, she is often found dispassionately staring off into space even in dire situations, seemingly indifferent to her surroundings.
67497: Karina is a first year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's the driver of Rabbit Team's M3 Lee. Karina comes from Hitachinaka, Ibaraki.
67499: Yuuki is a first year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's a member of the Rabbit Team and serves as the radio operator as well as 75mm loader of the M3 Lee. Yuuki comes from Hitachinaka, Ibaraki.
67501: Aya is a first year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's also the 37mm gunner of the Rabbit Team's U.S. M3 Lee. As a tank gunner, she is rather impulsive, prone to using her gun at every available opportunity.
69135: She is the Sensha-do instructor in Oarai Girl's High School.
69137: One of the "Noble Sisters" from St. Gloriana's Girls Academy. She is a third year. Her role is a commander in the Churchill tank. As the commanding officer at St. Gloriana, she leads the entire Panzer team. Her characteristic is the way she speaks in a high-handed manner.
69139: One of the "Noble Sisters" from St. Gloriana's Girls Academy. She is a third year. Her role is a gunner in the Churchill tank. Similar to Darjeeling, she likes jokes. Her rolling long locks of blonde hair is her defining characteristic.
69141: One of the "Noble Sisters" from St. Gloriana's Girls Academy. She is a first year. Her role is a loader in the Churchill tank. She is a person of few words, although she is good at accurately controlling a vehicle. Her name itself refers to a high grade of tea blend.
72519: Maho Nishizumi is the older sister of Miho Nishizumi and daughter of Shiho Nishizumi. Maho is a third year student at Kuromorimine Girls Academy, overall tank commander Kuromorimine's Sensha-dō team, and the heiress to the Nishizumi family's style of Sensha-dō.
72655: The energetic leader of the Saunders Sensha-dou team, portrayed as a stereotypical American, who is loud, boisterous, charismatic, and laid back. She believes that Sensha-dou is not war and believes in fair play.
72657: She is a member of Saunders University High School tank team, who serves as a gunner for the Sherman Firefly. Calm and cool, she is specialized in distance shooting and is often seen chewing gum while sniping her targets.
72659: A manipulative and aggressive radio operator who taps enemy communications to obtain an unfair advantage in combat. Commanded the flag tank in Saunders' match against Oarai in first round of the national Sensha-dou championship.
72661: "Duce" Anchovy is Anzio's overall commander, who uses a Carro Armato P 40 heavy tank. She wears the uniform of the Black Shirts, similar to that of Benito Mussolini.
72663: She's Captain of the Pravda High School team. Since she always gets remarks on her short stature, she is called the Tiny Tyrant.
72665: She's the vice commander of the Pravda Girls High School Sensha-Dō team, as well as its sniper. She mainly operates a Soviet T-34-85 tank, although she can also operate an IS-2 as well. In the anime, she only missed one shot when she served as the gunner of IS-2.
72667: Itsumi Erika, can be cold hearted when it comes to the heat of Sensha-do, she is second in command of the Kuromorimine Girl's high school the previously reigning Sensha-do champions for 9 years.
73269: Hana's mother, who, at first, was very reluctant to allow Hana to join the school's "Sensha-do" team because she feared that it will keep her from continuing their family tradition of "Ikebana."
73273: Midoriko is a third year student from Ooarai Girls High School, and the leader of the Public Morals Committee. She's the commander, 47mm gunner/loader and radio operator of Mallard Team and she operates a French Char B1 bis.
73685: Jungorou Akiyama is a local barber aboard the Ooarai Girls Academy carrier. He is the father of Yukari Akiyama.
75200: Moyoko is a second year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's a member of the public morals committee. She's the driver of Mallard Team's Char B1 bis.
75202: Nozomi is a second year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's a member of the public morals committee. She's the loader of the 75mm gun of Mallard Team's Char B1 bis.
76074: Mai is a second year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's also an online game fanatic. She's the tank commander and radio operator of the Anteater Team and she operates a Japanese Type 3 Chi-Nu.
76080: Reira is a third-year student from Oarai Girls' Academy. She's also a member of the automotive club. She's also the commander of Leopon Team, and she operates a German Tiger (P).
76082: Hoshino is a third year student from Ooarai Girls High School. She's also a member of the automotive club. She's also the gunner of the Leopon Team's Tiger (P) which only joined during the finals.
76084: Maria is a third year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's also a member of the automotive club. She's also the loader of the Leopon Team's Tiger (P).
76086: Tsuchiya is a second year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She is a member of the Automotive Club, as well as the driver for Leopon Team's Tiger (P).
76088: Aoi is a third year student from Ooarai Girls Academy. She's also an online game fanatic. She's also the gunner and loader of the Anteater Team's Type 3 Chi-Nu.
76090: Taki is a first year student from Ooarai Girls High School, She's an online game fanatic. She's also the driver of the Anteater Team's Type 3 Chi-Nu.
